nom: Ahava Purifying Mud Mask Detoxify & Purify

avis.texte: Ok the Dead Sea mud ahava has is WOW, The other products that have much of Dead Sea silt in it - are wonderful. The mud exfoliator is the yam of ahava. this mask - just made me think Why !?
Great product for large pores or breakouts. I love that it doesn't dry out my skin too much, like the majority of these types of products do
I use this nearly every day to remove redness in my sensitive face after plucking. Expensive but efficient.

I use this product after cleaning my face because it pulls the extra dirt and oils out without drying out my skin. After using my skin feels tighter and more rejuvenated. My pores also look smaller giving my face an even toned look.

Unlike other reviews, I do not think this mask has a strong smell, and it definitely does not burn. I love how quick and easy it is to use with immediate results! My skin is much smoother, and it helps clear my breakouts. I received the trial bottle with a purchase, and that small bottle has lasted me about 2 months with using it twice weekly. 100% worth it!

I always keep coming back to this mask - because it works! Brightens my skin and clears out the pores on my face. If I notice a breakout forming I use this at night and the next morning I have reduced and smaller acne breakouts.

avis.titre: So sad I finished this, absolutely gorgeous
avis.texte: I absolutely adored this mud mask. I got a travel sized version and it lasted a good few uses. This feels so smooth to apply and dries down well. It didn't irritate my skin at all and left my face looking amazing. This really works for clearing your skin. I will definitely buy the full size of this.

This is the best mud mask I have ever used! It's left my skin so soft and CLEAR! I've had a deep stubborn black head and with ONE USE it was gone! No pain, no redness! I personally recommend using it in the shower rather than leave it on to dry/tighten! I will be buying this again!

avis.titre: Best mask I've used for my pores and occasional breakouts!
avis.texte: I use this mask at the end of every week. After having makeup and sunscreen on my face during the week there is nothing else that cleans out my pores like this mask. I also love using it to spot treat any acne that may pop up during "that time of the month". It just sucks all the gunk and dirt right out!

avis.titre: this cleared my skin right up
avis.texte: I got a sample of this mask in a recent purchase, and I really like it! I usually stick to only Dermalogica but this mask really works amazing. it clears my skin right up and doesn't dry it out at all. I have reordered a full size!

avis.titre: I'm always looking for new offerings from AHAVA.
avis.texte: This AHAVA mask isn't harsh; the experience is relaxing. The results are brightening and smoothing.

Contrary to previous reviews this mask does not have strong smell of sulphur and it also did not burn. I did like the feel of the mask and I like that the mask doesn't need a long time to harden up. Too soon to comment specifically about the results.
This mask smells strongly of sulfur. I can't get past the smell, I'll probably give it away!
It did its job of exfoliating my skin, but nothing extraordinary. Seems like a tried and true exfoliator that I would buy again.
I received this as a sample a long time ago and loved it. I saw there was a really good deal this time around and decided to purchase. It leaves the skin so soft and very clean.

I'm not sure how I feel about this mask. As some previous reviewers have said, it burns sensitive skin pretty badly, especially during the removal process. BUT it did make a pretty noticeable difference in terms of evening out my skin tone and cleaning out the large pores on my nose and cheeks. I've struggled to find products that do either of those things, so I am hesitant to throw this out based on the burning... I may use it one more time to see if results are consistent. If so, I may keep using it (maybe just once a week) and return to add a star. Otherwise, the pain just isn't worth it.
I have sensitive skin. Used this for the first time and it BURNS my skin.
Great product. Brings back wonderful memories of my tour to Israel and bit to Dead Sea!

I received this in an Ipsy bag months ago and purchased it immediately. I use this 2-3 times a week and couldn't be happier with it. It's very gentle, but leaves my face so soft and clean feeling. I tend to have problems with dry skin around my nose and chin and haven't had an issue with it at all since I have been using this.
I really loved this mask. I got it in my Ipsy bag. It really sucks the blackhead to the surface of your pores. Skin feels nice and refreshed after.

avis.titre: Best mask to clear skin & fade dark marks. Fast results!
avis.texte: This is the best mask I have ever used. I would recommend moisturizing right after using this.

This stuff is amazing! I have struggled with big pores, blackheads, and blemishes since I was about 10. I have Never found anything that works as good as this. I can tell a difference within 24 hours!
Ahava is an overseas company that still uses triclosan in their mud products. The reasons companies in the US removed it from hand sanitizers & other various products are quite sound.
i see a pimple and i apply a bit over it overnight the next day its literally almost gone. works very well and i love how it leaves my face.

I LOVE this product! However, its not a mask you use weekly and let dry on your face for 30-40 minutes. If you read the instructions- it's suggested that the mask is removed after only several minutes of application. So when I am halfway through my shower and have already cleansed my face- I apply the mask as my skin is damp and pores wide open. It leaves my skin glowing and prepped for my acne medication and moisturizer and then always provides a smooth canvas for makeup. Great for oily, congested and acne-prone skin such as mine.

avis.titre: Great product. Went to Israel to their lab from the dead sea
avis.texte: Right from the Dead Sea in Israel. Great for the skin...love it.

I initially received this in an Ipsy bag. It sat for awhile in my drawer with all of the other products until I had a terrible breakout. I'm 40 and have never had blemishes other than during "that time of the month". I tried this for the heck of it when I had a serious break out from new products. I love that it is very fast drying (2-4 minutes) and it isn't ridiculously thick. I'm not kidding, this cleared the pimples up within 24 hours. As soon as I washed it off, I could tell that the pimples were less pronounced. By the next morning, gone. I typically would never spend this much on a product but I just ordered the full size. I'm definitely a fan. Oh yeah, and I have pretty sensitive skin but this did not irritate me.

Proceed with caution. I tried this product twice, spaced a few weeks apart, and each time it caused me to break out in a bad rash. I don't normally have sensitive skin, so if you are someone who does you might think twice before trying this product.

I've used AHAVA for over 25 years, their mud line is so purifying and brightening. This is one product that I can't live without. I'm 51 and still get hormonal acne on my jawline (oh joy...) and this helps to manage the acne. I have used AHAVA since the 1990's, it's that good.
This product is great, only takes 2 minutes and my skin feels so great. I work in food service so I am prone to breakouts but I am diligent in my skincare routine. This is a must have!
You can't go wrong with Ahava. I used this mask as nightly spot treatment. Clears my acne up and not drying.

The instructions say to apply generously, but I apply a moderate amount in just the areas that I usually get oily, and it's not too drying. I appreciate that it comes in a tube instead of a tub so you can just squeeze it out, the texture is smoother and more consistent than other masks I've tried which makes it easy to apply in an even layer over the skin, and it's fragrance-free which is great.

avis.titre: i would refer this to a friend!
avis.texte: This product was the bees knees and really helped clear my skin!

avis.titre: Love this mud and I usually hate mud mask.
avis.texte: So I got this in my ipsy bag and I must say it pulls out my skins impurities better and faster than my other products. Use before applying makeup and I use the rubber applicator to apply and it's fairly easy. Doesn't dry down and easy to wash off. ❤️❤️

i only use this product when i break out badly and once i do my acne clears up. i only put this product on my acne prone areas. i have oily acne prone skin that is hard to clear and this product honestly works for me

I honestly didn't feel any difference after using this product.. I would continue to use it up anyway if it didn't smell like burnt rubber. It smells soooo bad it's intolerable. Highly do not recommend.

avis.titre: I love how my skin feels
avis.texte: I loved how quick and easy this was to use. Two minutes and your done! It tingles a little bit as it dries, I was worried cause I have really sensitive skin but I had no redness or irritation. My skin felt smooth, soft and hydrated. It says to use once or twice a week, I have only needed once a week to see the improvements of my skin. I recommend it to anyone looking to change their skincare routine and improve their skin!

Serious people...best mud/non-sheet face mask I have ever used (and I've tried a lot from cheap to very expensive). The one downside to mud/cream masks is the wait time, BUT this mask only takes 2-5 mins. max for this baby to produce results!! I received the trial size in my ipsy glam bag this month and was skeptical at first due to my very sensitive skin. However, this mask was perfect for my combination skin. I have oily skin with acne issues in the t-zone and chin with super dry areas where acne is healing. I used this mask on those "problem" areas while shaving my legs. The instructions say leave on for 2 mins....it actually was almost totally dry at 2 mins. When rinsing it off I scrubbed the mask in gentle circular motions over my entire face and neck for a quick exfoliation before rinsing completely off. The following morning when i woke up the massive breakout that was just starting on my forehead was gone! Almost all the acne bumps were GONE! I Would for sure recommend this to a friend...actually I already have but I'd also recommend this to anyone who suffers from acne, blackheads, whiteheads, or just needs a good pore detox/ quick but effevtive pamper shes. I will for sure be purchasing the fill size bottle on payday. I've actually used it twice now and its been preventing new acne from even showing up to the party...yay!! 10/10 nailed it with this mud mask! my search may finally be over thanks to ipsy and this product being in my glam bag! samples are Great, I know

This is the first time I've tried a mud mask. And I'm in love. One nice thing is you don't have to have it on for 20 min. I'm a busy mom and don't have that luxury. Face feels clean and refreshed. You definitely want to use a moisturizer afterwards.

This mask is easy to apply and only takes 2 minutes. It leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed but my pores are clogged still even though I've been using this on a regular basis for at least 2 months. I don't see any difference.

I was lucky enough to purchase this mask at the Ahava lab at the Dead Sea and honestly I bought it on impulse of being there. Otherwise I don't think I would purchase it again. It makes my skin feel fresh and clean but that is about it. It does not do much for my acne or pores.

avis.titre: Great mask to purify and clear  any enlarged pores
avis.texte: Recommended by my dermatologist. I use it only on areas where I tend to have slightly enlarged pores or clogged pores. It's not as harsh as others I had tried. Part of how I keep my over 50 skin looking years younger.

avis.titre: First time trying and has helped a lot
avis.texte: I bought this mask about 2 weeks ago and have been using it every three days, but i leave it on for 15 minutes since it doesn't irritate and i'm left with a deeper clean-feeling. I believe the price is a bit high, but it has gotten rid of my face's extra oils. I just wish it worked better for my acne, i feel it dries pimples out but the next morning they sprout back... other than that i really enjoy using it and my skin is cleaner, and more even-toned.

got this as a sample and since adding it into my routine i've noticed that my skin is glowing. it's a bit drying but i have oily skin so it's just right for me. if you have acne or tend to break out this is a great mask to use because it dries those breakouts right up! for oily/combo/acne prone skin this is a gem because it balances everything out. not sure if i'd pay this much for a mask though

I only tried the sample size for one-time use so I can't speak to the mask's effectiveness over time. I have normal to combination skin, with some clogged pores and early fine lines, occasional breakouts. This mask is quick and refreshing. It goes on thick and creamy and spreads easily. Right away I could feel a cooling, almost tingling sensation under the mask that lasted until I rinsed it off. It's gentle, though, and not at all burning or uncomfortable. I considered leaving the mask on longer to dry but decided to go ahead and rinse. Takes a bit to rinse completely off and felt best with semi-cool water. Once my skin dried though my complexion appeared refreshed and clear. Not sure if this would be moisturizing or plumping for fine lines/wrinkles or if it would really help smooth clogged pore bumps.

There is no mask I personal have found to match this one. It actually does the trick but here's the trick... I don't follow the directions. My skin is very oily and thick so it takes a lot to permeate the layers and so instead of leaving on for two minutes, I leave on for a half hour. Then I rinse, pat dry, and re-apply another layer and let that sit another 20-30 mins. No matter what I've tried, that second layer is key.

avis.titre: Ok Face Mask. Great for Deep Exfoliating!
avis.texte: I purchased this in my quest of finding a great mud mask that can draw out impurities, help with acne blemishes and control oil. Well this one isn't that. I applied the mask and after a few minutes it dried down almost invisible on my skin. When I wet my face to remove the mask using my hands, it reactived the mask into a creamy, exfoliating lather. After I washed it off, my face felt clean and that's it. Didn't help with blemishes and it controlled my oily skin like when wash my face with Philosophy Purity face wash. This mask is great for people with normal skin with no skin issues looking for a basic mask. If you're looking for more, this isn't it.
I actually bought this as a sample. It cleared my skin on my bad acne days. It's an amazing product, I don't mind spending the money now because it's worth it.

This mask is amazing, I wish it was at a lower price so I could buy it more often. I have sensitive and combination skin, this leaves my skin feeling beautiful after I use it, every time. My face is more even and helps any acne I have heal. Great product, love it!

So I got this fun size as a free gift when I purchased some eyebrow stuff...anyway, I decided to try it due to having some breakouts on my plump cheeks (yes sarcasm) and having acne scars...I've used this twice so far and it has really been helping in treating the acne and fading away the scars. I love it!
I like that you only leave it on for 2 minutes, and it washes off easily.
Very happy with this Ulta Beauty Break item, and will get the full size. Not harsh on sensitive skin. Leaves skin soft and smooth.

I have been using this twice a week on my upper back and shoulders. It has helped greatly to clear up the breakouts that I normally get over the winter. It has also helped the skin to be less oily. I love how it makes my skin feel.

My gf got me this for my birthday and i was so happy after trying it out! This is a lovely mask, not too thick and really cleans the face well. My skin felt so smooth and clean. The next few days i can still feel it! I love the line of products as i also have the hand cream (which is amazing btw) and now i am purchasing the moisturizer.

I bought this product after a trip to the Dead Sea in Israel. It really is just like the mud there, minus the rocks! I've begun using the mask once a week and I love how my face feels afterwards. Highly recommend.
Ahava mask is highly suggested even over other expensive brands. Skin is smoothe and radiant after use. I benefit from using on weekly basis.
I bought this on a whim to try and after the first use I like it my skin was soft and all was well. On the second use it broke my skin out and made the redness in my cheeks worse also dried me out

There are a lot of mud masks on the market and I'm a sucker for them. I enjoy trying new mud masks. You get the feel of a spa day without leaving the house. The AHAVA mud mask is quite nice! It left my skin feeling soft and rejuvenated. The results are seen over the course of a few days after using the mask. So, it gets better and better! I like that you don't need to have it on for a long period of time.

I would not recommend this product for dry skin, sensitive skin and certainly not rosacea skin. I had used clay masks in the past that actually helped with the redness from my rosacea but this irritated my face and made it worse. I think this would probably work well for normal or oily skin but if you are the least bit sensitive I would stay away.

I am 26 and have clear skin every where EXCEPT on the sides of my chin. I have naturally very oily sensitive skin, and I feel like I've been battling breakouts since I was 14. I've never had deep cystic acne or blackheads, but I am prone to the medium sized pimples and closed comedones/white heads which have only gotten worse during my cycle even though I am on Yaz BC. Anyway, I was having a particularly bad breakout on both sides of my chin and was at my wit's end. I read a million mask reviews and finally decided to give this one a try. Best decision I've made in a long time- I bought it yesterday, used it for 5 minutes, and woke up today with 99% of my chin breakouts GONE. Both sides probably had 4-5 small closed comedone pumps that I could not cover with makeup and just looked awful. They are now completely flat, dried up and no longer itchy/irritated. THIS IS AMAZING! None of the traditional acne products (BP, AHA/SA, etc) worked yet this did almost overnight.
I had used a product that had to purchased from a rep (from the sea...) that cost more than $60 for less product. This works great for a fraction of the price.

I was amazed when I washed off the mud mask. I thought perhaps I had not removed it all, because my skin was so very soft. It was a great feeling. I plan to use it twice a week, as recommended. I actually bought a second tube this week. It's too bad it to see that it's being discontinued. I hope there is a good replacement.

I really enjoyed this product. I've used it for a while and it really works. It helps to make your face smooth and hydrated. It makes it feel relieved when it comes off. It only take two minutes, too!!
Just amazing, sooo hard to find a good mud mask, and like it heated my face a little which was relaxing, like I felt it work instantly! So glad I bought 2 of this! And it was only for 2 mins!

avis.titre: WOW! Haven't tried anything better!! Immediate results!
avis.texte: After a week long vacation in the sun, in cholorine filled pools all day,and covered in sunscreen everyday I decided to treat myself to using my sample of the AHAVA mask and WOW!! I'm speechless (almost ;) )!! My skin looks and feels amazing!! I mean as soon as I washed the mask off my skin was glowing and felt so refreshed! My skin tends to be very oily, I have large pores and get blackheads easily and this mask seemed to clean them out!! I'm so glad I got this sample in my ipsy bag! I will definetly be splurging to buy the full size!!

avis.titre: Love the way my skin feels with the product!
avis.texte: I use this in the shower 1-2 times a week. It makes my skin feel amazing and the next day I notice that it doesn't cause breakout like some masks do. My skin has a healthy glow that I only get from this mud mask.

I love this mask! I searched the internet after many failed attempts at finding a good mask for my acne. I use honey as a cleanser which cleared a lot of my skin but I like clay masks to help really get in there. I have sensitive skin, like everything made me break out or puff out so I was very apprehensive to pay the money for this mask, but I saw good reviews so I did. I saw results the next morning. My skin looked good, smooth, no blackheads, inflamed acne was hardly visible. I would highly recommend this to anyone.

I have a bad habit of standing in front of the mirror after I wash my face and pick at all my pores, and pop pimples...Once I'm done, my face gets irritated, my pores get bigger, and my skin is so red I always try to layer on acne treatment lotions, but I found that Ahava Mud Mask is the ONLY thing that works. I put a generous amount of the mask on my biggest problem areas, then coat the rest of my face and I leave it on it dries, or my skin is so tight I can't move. I rinse it off, and my skin is super smooth and ready for any post acne clearing treatment lotion, and I go to bed. When I wake up in the morning, all the areas where I touched and opened up my pores are completely healed and acne free! It's honestly so amazing, buy the small sample size, because it is expensive, but I touch my skin constantly and always search for pores to pop, so I use this very often and it hasn't disappointed me yet!! SO AMAZING, BUY IT!!

I tried this out last night for the very first time. This mud mask is made with the most natural ingredients and is supposed to be very purifying and cleansing. I've never tried a mud mask before, so this is all new to me. It comes out of the bottle looking literally like mud. It has a very earthy, non-fragrant scent. This is paraben free, which is awesome. I followed the instructions and left it on for three minutes. It hardens like a rock on your face, so it does make you feel stiff after it's been on a while. It rinses off ok, but is difficult to come out of a wash cloth, so I'd recommend using an old one and dedicating it for this purpose only. Overall, I like it, I felt more clean afterwards, and I will continue to use it once a week as per the directions. I like the results I have seen so far, and my acne has lessened from where it was.

This mask really works. I use it often, because it really helps clear up acne super fast - can make it disappear overnight sometimes. This makes my skin so soft & supple. I do have dry skin, and though I haven't noticed it dry out my skin further, I do make sure to moisturize well after use. This product is a must have to help keep skin clear, smooth, and soft.

avis.titre: Works great, but stains clothes & towels
avis.texte: I use this roughly once a week. It works great and makes my skin cleaner and clearer, as I tend to break out and I am getting too old for breakouts, so this is a very good product (and I have tried many). I have far less breakouts with this as part of my skin care routine. To me this is as good if not better than the pricy $69.00 mask that people rave about. Very good at keeping oil at bay. Now for the staining. I am admittedly sloppy when I rinse this off and some water splashess from the sink/my face onto my blouse, onto the chest area. I've ruined a couple blouses and a couple towels before I figured out something about this must be staining (actually bleaching out, I should say) my clothing and towels. I rinse really well, so not sure how the towels are getting bleached out so badly from this. The blouse I can somewhat understand as it gets the splashing. But by time I dry my face with a towel from using this, the product should be well-rinsed. Puzzling. But my answer is to wear old white tops and use old white towels when I use this. Had to take one star off for that. Never had a product do this, and I have used several products over the years. It is nice though that it has very little smell. If your skin is dry you might need a good moistuizer right after this. Works great in my opinion, just not sure why it bleaches things out. That all said yes I would recommend this to a friend (with the above precautions).
This is the best mask I have ever tried. In 4 minutes makes my skin as soft and young looking as it was when I was young
I received this as a deluxe sample in a prior Ulta gift, and ever since then I am hooked! My skin feels so refreshed, soft, and radiant after using it. This mask is one of my must-haves for sure!

avis.titre: This Purifying Mask is simply AMAZING!
avis.texte: I use this product in the shower, usually about once a week. It smells great! And it also makes your face feel super soft when you're done. I cannot find anything I do not like about this product.
so far I have only used once,but Iliked it left my skin feeling clean and soft.

I based these results from my daughters comments. I bought this for her and she really liked it. She's 26 and loves the way her skin felt afterwards...she was pleased and I was happy I got a good product for her!

avis.titre: Love this product for my acne-prone skin
avis.texte: I use this on my entire face once a week to help reduce oiliness and breakouts. I'll also use it as a spot treatment for large, painful acne- leave it on overnight and in the morning most of the inflammation will be gone.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: I use this product twice a week and iv been loving it so far. Its a great mask.
It's quick to use and doesn't dry my skin out. It pulls impurities out.

avis.titre: Works good, face felt soft after
avis.texte: I liked this product. The only downside is the price but it did a good job. My face felt felt nice and soft and pores seemed smaller.

This product worked great on my coppery brown skin. I love using it at night, because it ensures that I wake up to a smooth and clear complexion in the morning. It's even great for spot treatment on problem areas in between the twice a week suggested us. I have already recommended this to my other black female friends. Love, love, love this stuff!
I would recommend this to any one that is looking to use a mask in their facial treatments. It shows immediate results and also relaxes me after and during use.

I have been looking for a green mud mask that doesn't overdry or irritate my skin. I have used Ahava products in the past and feel they are a trustworthy brand. The price was reasonable as well. My skin has an oily t-zone with acne on the chin periodically and dry cheeks. This product smoothed out my dry area, soaked up the oily areas and shrunk/diminshed the redness in the breakouts. Also, the product comes of easily with warm washcloth. My skin was non-irritated and I get red very easily so that is proof enough for me.
It helps with acne but also helps your skin appear less red and not enflamed.

avis.titre: Excellent for oily, acne prone skin.
avis.texte: Very effective in clearing clogged pores. Tightens skin and improves circulation. Really helps to improve the look and feel of oily, acne prone skin when used on a regular basis.

The product does what it says. I was surprised at how fast it works - it really does only take a few minutes to dry and suck out the oil/makeup/whatever else shouldn't be on your face. I have sensitive skin and it didn't bother it, and it seems like it'd be okay for dry skin too. However, it is meant to dry it out a little, so if you have dry skin, I'd check the return policy before trying it out, just in case.

I got this as a sample from my work a few months ago and ignored it for a while but when I finally used it, I've never looked back! It smells kind of weird but I suppose most mud masks do. That would be my only complaint- This mask makes me skin instantly softer, more even and seems to sooth red acne marks immediately. LOVE IT!
I have had a difficult time finding facial clensers and masks that are gental on my sensitive skin, but strong enough to help deal with my oily skin. So far I am VERY happy with this product
